setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4; c.go('SO-03'); const T=c.T, v=T.v; const L=['',v.plan.console,'enable',v.plan.secret,'configure terminal'].concat(v.kind==='user'?['username '+v.user+' secret '+v.pw]:['interface vlan 1','ip address '+v.newIp+' '+v.plan.mask],['end','copy running-config startup-config','']); c.guess('right'); L.forEach(l=>c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'tech',line:l,cli:true})); if(v.kind==='user'){c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'pc',line:'ssh '+v.user+'@'+v.plan.ip}); c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'pc',line:v.pw,cli:true});} else c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'pc',line:'ping '+v.newIp}); document.getElementById('board').scrollIntoView();
